messages:
Jamie: Quick sync — ran a short GPTQ sweep (Llama / Mistral / Qwen) on staging to find candidates we can ship for Dedicated. Goal: <=1% MMLU drop vs FP16, and obvious perf/cost wins. 8xA100 run, mixed sequence lengths.
Suresh: awesome — rough numbers?
Jamie: TL;DR: Mistral7B-AWQ looks best for 4-bit; Llama-3-13B-GPTQ close but KV cache jitter on long context; Qwen-14B-GPTQ has some regressions on multichoice.
Kai: can you paste the eval run commands so we can reproduce?
Jamie: sure — harness snippet: ```./eval.sh --model {model} --tasks mmlu,boolq,arc --batch 8 --seq 512 --seed 42 --quant gptq```
Jamie: Llama-3-13b-gptq-q4  (seeded run):
```
MMLU: FP16=72.4, GPTQ-Q4=71.5  (-0.9)
BoolQ F1: FP16=86.2, GPTQ-Q4=85.1  (-1.1)
Throughput (tokens/s): FP16=120, GPTQ-Q4=98
KV-cache memory delta: +12% under longcontext workloads
```
Aisha: -0.9 MMLU is fine if latency/cost look good. Throughput drop is concerning though. Where did the time go?
Jamie: suspected kernel choices — GPTQ path couldn't use the fused attention kernels in some layers, so CPU fallback for some ops. Suresh / eng-runtime to confirm.
Suresh: noted. I see in runtime logs several "fallback to generic attention" events. Can you attach log snippet?
Jamie: pasted minimal log: ```WARN runtime: layer12 attention kernel not supported -> generic_attention.cu fallback (20ms extra)
WARN runtime: kv-cache align mismatch -> reserialize (approx 8ms)` ````
Meera: Mistral7b-awq-q4:
```
MMLU: FP16=67.1, AWQ-Q4=66.8  (-0.3)
BoolQ F1: FP16=83.0, AWQ-Q4=82.6  (-0.4)
Throughput: FP16=210, AWQ-Q4=260  (+24%)
Tail latency p95: FP16=48ms, AWQ-Q4=38ms
```
Kai: nice — throughput win and tiny accuracy hit. Any stability issues?
Jamie: none in 10k samples. KV-cache behaved fine. Memory footprint down ~45%.
Aisha: Qwen14b?
Jamie: Qwen-14b-gptq-hetero: 
```
MMLU: FP16=74.0, GPTQ-h=72.3  (-1.7)
CODE eval: large regressions in multi-step reasoning prompts (~3-5% absolute)
Throughput: FP16=95, GPTQ-h=130 (+37%)
```
Jamie: Observed hallucination/chain-of-thought regressions on some datasets — looks like quant noise amplifies in deeper decoding.
Suresh: for deployment profile I propose:
- Mistral7b-AWQ-Q4 -> default low-tier for bursty traffic
- Llama-3-13b-GPTQ-Q4 -> canary on Dedicated with short-context routes only
- Qwen-14b-GPTQ -> hold until we run more regen tests / or serve as fallback FP16 only
Meera: agree. Add rollout flags: canary=10%, canary_seq_limit=512, fallback_route=fp16 when per-request regression triggers >0.8% quality drop.
Aisha: who owns QA eval for Qwen regression hunt?
Jamie: Kai + Aisha. Kai will expand prompt set; Aisha will run long-context KV stress tests.
ci-bot: Build 2026.3.14-gptq-sweep completed — artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-eval/gptq/4567890123/ 
Jamie: next steps/action items:
- @Suresh: confirm attention kernel patch ETA (2d?) and list affected layers.
- @Kai, @Aisha: expanded evals for Qwen and longer chain-of-thought cases (48h).
- @Meera: add rollout config and canary route in console.
Everyone: reactions if you agree :eyes: :thumbsup: :warning:
Suresh: ack, starting kernel triage.
Kai: on it, will push prompt suite by EOD.
Aisha: starting stress runs now, will report by tomorrow morning.
Jamie: thanks — will open a short PR with the summarized profiles and metric thresholds.
